notes: Kairoi Residential: kairoi.com/find-a-home/ listed all 25 CO communities directly with each property's own marketing domain link (utm_source=corporateweb params stripped); no vendor-hosted or blocked-domain links encountered; page was not JS-only. No street addresses were shown on that listing page, so address is null for all Kairoi entries (not guessed). UDR: udr.com currently operates only ONE Colorado community (Cirrus, Denver/West Colfax), confirmed via udr.com/denver-apartments/, udr.com/search-apartments/, and udr.com/site-map/. Cirrus has no separate marketing domain -- it is hosted entirely on udr.com, so own_domain=false and marketing_url points to its udr.com page. Greystar: greystar.com/browse-apartments (and /homes-to-rent) is Greystar's own property-search portal; it lists communities by CO market (Denver Metro, Colorado Springs Metro, Fort Collins-Loveland Metro). The Denver Metro, Colorado Springs, and Fort Collins-Loveland-Greeley market pages each listed full community rosters with names/addresses/links; Boulder/Longmont and Durango market pages returned only generic marketing copy with no named communities (JS-driven listing that WebFetch could not extract) -- so Boulder and Durango Greystar communities could NOT be enumerated and are NOT included here (a real gap in coverage, not zero properties). For every individual Greystar community detail page fetched (197 total), a 'Visit Property Website' link to the property's own distinct marketing domain was found and used as marketing_url with tracking query params stripped; none pointed to the forbidden vendor-leasing domains, so vendor_hosted is false / vendor is null throughout. No rent or availability data was collected for any property, per instructions. Overall: 223 total CO candidate communities (197 Greystar, 25 Kairoi Residential, 1 UDR). Known gap: Greystar communities in Boulder/Longmont and Durango, CO markets are not enumerated because those market pages did not expose a community list via WebFetch.
